Overnight risk: a close back below the 770.49 flip into the 772 put wall would flip dealers to amplifying; the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items, the 8/11 calendar has no scheduled high-importance release, and the next scheduled item is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28.
